sens_en: to put, to let go, to release
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 放 par « chasser » : 攴, la main qui frappe, pour le sens, et 方 pour le son. 方 se lit fāng, la même syllabe que 放, fàng. De chasser, on est passé à lâcher, puis à poser : 放下, c'est reposer.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 放 as “to drive away”: 攴, the striking hand, for the meaning, and 方 for the sound. 方 is read fāng, the same syllable as 放, fàng. From driving off, the meaning moved to letting go, then to putting down: 放下 means to set down.

mots.en: to finish school for the day

phrase.en: We finish school in the afternoon.
